prs.title: Remove obsolete protected-path monitoring from the Linux sandbox
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Remove obsolete protected-path monitoring from the Linux sandbox

## Why

Missing protected metadata paths already receive read-only synthetic mounts, as established in https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/39629. The fallback creation monitor no longer receives any targets because those paths are included in the read-only mount list.

## What changed

Remove `ProtectedCreateTarget` tracking and its inotify monitor, deletion fallback, registry markers, startup pipe, and policy-violation exit override. Keep synthetic mount cleanup and propagate the bubblewrap child's exit status directly.

prs.title: Use a synchronous mutex for remote metadata request tracking
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Use a synchronous mutex for remote metadata request tracking

## What changed

Replace the Tokio mutex protecting `RemoteFileSystem`'s in-flight metadata request map with `std::sync::Mutex`. Keep metadata I/O outside the lock and centralize locking in a helper that recovers poisoned guards.

Update the existing concurrent metadata request test to use the locking helper.

prs.title: Add streaming file replacement to filesystem abstractions
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Add streaming file replacement to filesystem abstractions

## What changed

Add `write_file_stream` to `ExecutorFileSystem` and `EnvironmentAccess`, preserving the accessor's captured sandbox permissions. Local and streaming-capable remote filesystems replace files one bounded chunk at a time and return the byte count. Older executors buffer the input before sending a single `writeFile` request.

Close remote handles on completion or failure, perform best-effort cleanup after cancellation, and invalidate pending metadata lookups. Document that failure or cancellation can leave a truncated or partial file and that in-flight I/O may outlive cancellation.

## Testing

Add coverage for sequential writes, binary and empty files across local and remote filesystems, source failures, handle cleanup, metadata invalidation after cancellation, and compatibility with older executors.

prs.title: Upgrade V8 to 152.2.0 and backport Array.sort safety guards
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Upgrade V8 to 152.2.0 and backport Array.sort safety guards

## Why

Optimized `Array.prototype.sort` can write objects into incompatible array element storage when receiver element kinds differ and the comparator mutates the array.

## What changed

- Upgrade `v8` to `152.2.0`, the Bazel V8 source to `15.2.124.1`, and ICU data and initialization to version 78.
- Backport element-kind agreement checks for sort inlining in TurboFan and Maglev. Apply the patch to Bazel builds and Windows MSVC source builds, and include it in source-build cache keys and canary triggers.
- Refresh pinned sandbox archives and bindings, extend Bazel prebuilt coverage to musl Linux, and use matching sandbox bindings on Windows MSVC.
- Update Bazel integration patches and runtime dependencies for the new V8 release, and download the pinned Windows build tools in source-build workflows.

## Testing

Include the upstream sort regression test covering mixed element kinds, comparator mutation, and continued optimization for matching kinds. Add a test requiring canary and Windows source builds when the backport changes, and update artifact-fetch tests for the new version.

prs.title: Preserve evidence message structure in Guardian Decisions requests
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Preserve evidence message structure in Guardian Decisions requests

## Why

The optional Guardian Decisions comparison rejected non-user messages and trusted skill evidence, and folded trusted tool evidence into the classification rubric.

## What changed

Send evidence as separate messages with their original roles, content order, boundaries, and optional `phase`. Support both `input_text` and `output_text`, keeping trusted tool and skill evidence separate from the rubric. Continue to accept inline images only in user messages and reject unsupported evidence.

## Testing

Update adapter and HTTP contract tests to cover mixed message roles and assistant output. Extend lifecycle coverage to verify that trusted skill evidence reaches Decisions while comparison results leave the baseline risk unchanged.

prs.title: Capture sender context for `codex_app.create_thread` deliveries
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Capture sender context for `codex_app.create_thread` deliveries

## What changed

Recognize `codex_app.create_thread` deliveries when capturing sender context so Guardian receives the sender's recent user messages and assistant context for delegated tasks.

## Testing

Extend the sender-context integration test to cover `create_thread`, including reviewer-only context and clearing the snapshot on a subsequent delivery without sender provenance.

prs.title: Bind plugin hook approval to plugin contents
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Bind plugin hook approval to plugin contents

## Why

A plugin's scripts can change without changing its hook declaration. Declaration-only approval therefore lets changed plugin code run under an existing hook approval.

## What changed

- Fingerprint plugin bundle contents and include the content hash in the approval value returned by `hooks/list`. Persist it as `trusted_content_hash`, keeping `trusted_hash` compatible with older clients.
- Verify contents before each command or MCP hook execution, within the hook's timeout, and require renewed approval when approved contents change.
- Migrate legacy declaration-only approvals to a shared, immutable content baseline per plugin and config home.
- Exclude generated Python bytecode, `.venv`, and `.egg-info` entries from fingerprints. Run app-server hook listing on blocking tasks.

## Testing

Extend integration coverage for plugin upgrades and rollbacks requiring approval, same-turn script changes preventing further hook execution, shared legacy approval baselines, and generated Python artifacts preserving trust.

prs.title: Resolve stable releases dynamically for exec-server compatibility tests
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Resolve stable releases dynamically for exec-server compatibility tests

## What changed

Replace fixed release pins for app-server/exec-server compatibility tests with the latest stable version and the stable release published closest to 60 days ago. Exclude drafts and prereleases, and prefer the higher version when publication dates are equally close.

Resolve release versions and SHA-256 asset digests before Linux Bazel CI runs, passing them through `CODEX_COMPAT_RELEASES` to the release archive repositories. Reuse the argument comment lint action so it also prepares compatibility releases. Add bounded retries for transient GitHub release reads.

## Testing

Add unit coverage for stable release filtering, version ordering, nearest publication dates, tie-breaking, and deduplication when both selections resolve to the same release.

prs.title: Preserve disconnect reasons in Noise handshake errors
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Preserve disconnect reasons in Noise handshake errors

## Why

Noise handshake failures before connection readiness returned a generic error even when the transport had reported a specific disconnect reason. No `RpcClient` was reading the connection event channel at that point.

## What changed

Read the pending disconnect event when a Noise rendezvous handshake fails and append its reason to the handshake error when available.

## Testing

Add a regression test covering unexpected text frames and relay stream resets, checking that each produces the expected transport reason in the handshake error.

prs.title: Stream rollout records during thread history materialization
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Stream rollout records during thread history materialization

## Why

Thread history materialization allocated a buffer for the entire unread rollout suffix before processing records, increasing memory use for large rollouts.

## What changed

Read records incrementally with a buffered reader bounded to the captured file end. Reuse the line buffer, preserve trailing partial records for the next pass, and report unexpected EOF if the rollout shrinks during reading.

## Testing

Extend the partial-line boundary test with 64 KiB of padding per record to verify byte offsets and deferred processing until the final newline is durable.

prs.title: Retry npm release publishing and match macOS verification runners
Make remote-control conflict retry tests deterministic
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Make remote-control conflict retry tests deterministic

## What changed

Wait for the rejected socket to close before advancing Tokio's clock through
capped retry delays. Keep socket I/O on real time so pending handshakes cannot
auto-advance their own timeouts.

Return bodyless HTTP 409 responses in the test server, check that neither
rejection restarts fast retries, and assert that recovery preserves the expected
reconnect attempt count. Both cursor and cursorless cases use the updated helper.

prs.title: Prefer resource-specific scopes during MCP OAuth discovery
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Prefer resource-specific scopes during MCP OAuth discovery

## Why

Authorization server metadata can advertise scopes unrelated to the MCP resource. Using that list for discovery can request broader scopes than the resource requires.

## What changed

Update `rmcp` and use its initial scope selection during OAuth discovery: prefer scopes from the initial `WWW-Authenticate` challenge, fall back to protected resource metadata, and include `offline_access` when supported. Stop using the authorization server's general scope list as the discovered resource scopes.

## Testing

Add coverage for challenge scope precedence, resource metadata fallback, scope normalization, and exclusion of unrelated authorization server scopes. Add a no-browser login regression test for a preregistered client whose authorization server advertises neither scopes nor dynamic registration.

prs.title: Allow dynamic tool calls to execute in parallel
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Allow dynamic tool calls to execute in parallel

## Why

Dynamic tool calls should remain independent while waiting for client responses, so one pending call does not block another from reaching the client.

## What changed

Enable parallel execution in `DynamicToolHandler`, allowing code mode programs to issue concurrent dynamic tool calls with `Promise.all`.

## Testing

Add a code mode regression test that waits for two dynamic tool requests before responding, resolves them in reverse order, and verifies that `Promise.all` preserves the expected result order.

prs.title: Honor MCP tool-list changes within a turn
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Honor MCP tool-list changes within a turn

## Why

MCP servers can expose new tools during discovery. Refreshing the catalog after a tool-list notification lets Codex discover and call those tools in the same turn.

## What changed

- Add the disabled-by-default `mcp_tool_list_changed` feature for ordinary MCP servers.
- Track notifications in transport order and refresh catalogs before subsequent discovery or tool binding. Coalesce concurrent refreshes and retry listings invalidated by notifications, including during pagination.
- Retain the previous catalog on refresh failure, apply a retry cooldown, and invalidate affected startup caches. Allow notification refreshes to proceed while admitted calls finish.

## Testing

Add coverage for same-turn discovery and invocation in direct and Code Mode, notifications during startup and pagination, disabled behavior, cache invalidation, and concurrent refreshes with timeout recovery.

prs.title: Distinguish retryable thread-store errors from unknown write outcomes
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Distinguish retryable thread-store errors from unknown write outcomes

## What changed

Add `ThreadStoreError::Retryable` for transient failures known to be safe to retry and `ThreadStoreError::OutcomeUnknown` for writes that may already have committed. Recovery remains the operation owner's responsibility; neither category automatically triggers retries.

Preserve existing app-server error mappings and fatal session startup behavior, and report the new categories in shutdown diagnostics without exposing raw error payloads.

## Testing

Add coverage for conservative SQLx error classification, mutation error mappings, session initialization categories, and shutdown diagnostics that omit raw error payloads.

prs.title: Use shared Bazel CI preparation for lint and V8 jobs
Add an opt-in tool for copying files between environments
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Add an opt-in tool for copying files between environments

## What changed

Add the `codex-multi-env-copy-file` extension, exposing `multi_env_copy_file` when registered by the host. Copy files between distinct selected environments without loading their contents into model context, and return `bytes_copied` on completion.

Require absolute paths in each environment's native path convention and enforce each endpoint's sandbox policy and permission grants. Stream file contents where supported, with a buffered fallback for older executors. Reject same-environment copies and report I/O error kinds without exposing connection details. Warn that failed writes may leave a truncated or partially written target.

## Testing

Add integration tests for binary transfers in both directions, local and remote executors, path validation, opt-in tool visibility, endpoint permissions and grants, and unavailable or disconnected executors. Verify that copied contents stay outside model context.

prs.title: Distinguish MCP approval cancellation reasons
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Distinguish MCP approval cancellation reasons

## Why

MCP tool calls reported every aborted approval as "user cancelled MCP tool call", including interrupted requests and automatic cancellations in `exec` mode.

## What changed

Carry `user`, `interrupted`, or `non_interactive` cancellation reasons through MCP approval metadata and resolution. Mark explicit TUI cancellations as user actions, interrupted requests as interruptions, and automatic `exec` cancellations as non-interactive.

Use the reason to report when a call was cancelled before approval or because interactive approval is unavailable in `exec` mode. Preserve the existing cancellation message for clients that omit the reason.

## Testing

Update tests to verify that a closed approval response carries the interruption reason and that `exec` cancellation responses include the non-interactive reason.

prs.title: Keep TUI session selections bound to their backend
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Keep TUI session selections bound to their backend

## Why

A thread ID alone does not identify the backend that owns a session. Resume and fork selections must retain that ownership across connection replacement so they cannot operate on another backend, even when thread IDs match.

## What changed

- Add a process-local `BackendId` to app-server sessions and session targets, preserving it across reconnects and auxiliary picker connections.
- Reject selections from a different backend before changing session state or sending resume, fork, or unarchive requests.
- Disable local-daemon fallback to an embedded server for auxiliary pickers and after selecting a session, while retaining fallback for fresh startup.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for foreign selections with matching thread IDs, startup resume and fork rejection before requests, shared ownership across picker connections, and fallback eligibility.

prs.title: Preserve MCP tool-list metadata in server status
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Preserve MCP tool-list metadata in server status

## Why

MCP tool discovery discarded response-level `_meta`, leaving server-status clients unable to inspect metadata associated with the tool catalog.

## What changed

- Preserve opaque `_meta` from the first `tools/list` page through catalog refreshes and caches.
- Expose it as `toolListMeta` in `McpServerStatus`, with `null` when unavailable, and update generated schemas and bindings.
- Scope cached Apps catalog metadata to discovery settings, including client capabilities and extensions, while retaining tools from older caches without metadata.
- Restrict server capabilities in status snapshots to the selected servers.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for listing legacy cached Apps tools during failed startup, and update protocol serialization expectations for nullable `toolListMeta`.

prs.title: Honor home deletion preferences during Windows uninstall
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Honor home deletion preferences during Windows uninstall

## What changed

Read `desktop.uninstall_codex_home` from the owner's current `config.toml` before recursively deleting a desktop-created Codex home during Windows sandbox uninstall.

- Preserve the home by default for ordinary installations; retain the deletion default for OEM preinstalls when no preference is set.
- Let an explicit boolean preference override either default. Preserve the home when configuration is unreadable, malformed, or contains an invalid preference.
- Capture OEM metadata before Windows removes it during uninstall, and revoke sandbox permissions on retained homes.

## Testing

Add unit tests for missing preferences, explicit overrides, malformed or invalid configuration, and configuration read failures across both installation defaults.

prs.title: Move V8's ICU Bazel rules into the workspace
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Move V8's ICU Bazel rules into the workspace

## What changed

Add `third_party/v8/icu.BUILD.bazel` and wire V8's ICU repository to use it instead of patching upstream `bazel/BUILD.icu`.

Select ICU's custom libc++ flags and runtime dependencies through `//third_party/v8:use_rusty_v8_custom_libcxx`, keeping ICU aligned with V8 and its host generators.

prs.title: Keep prereleases in draft until release assets finish uploading
Preserve prereleased events when creating GitHub prereleases
Enable BuildBuddy for voice release builds
Close arg0 lock files before removing temporary directories
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Close arg0 lock files before removing temporary directories

## Why

Removing a directory while its lock file is open can leave `.nfs*` entries on NFS and prevent cleanup.

## What changed

- Drop the `Arg0PathEntryGuard` lock file before its temporary directory.
- On Unix, rename stale helper directories while locked, then close the lock before deleting them. This prevents initializers from publishing at the old path during cleanup.

## Testing

Extend the guard lifetime test to all platforms and assert that its directory is removed after main returns. Strengthen the janitor test to check that cleanup leaves the temporary root empty.

prs.title: Gate the file-copy extension behind `multi_env_copy_file`
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Gate the file-copy extension behind `multi_env_copy_file`

## What changed

Add the `multi_env_copy_file` feature flag, disabled by default and marked as under development, to the feature registry and configuration schema. Install the file-copy extension in app-server threads and CLI debug prompt construction when the flag is enabled.

prs.title: Render slash command prefixes as composer prompt markers
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Render slash command prefixes as composer prompt markers

## What changed

- Display the leading `/` in the prompt marker instead of the editable text, sharing prefix state with shell mode's `!`.
- Preserve command prefixes and text element offsets across submission, queuing, history, and external editing. Keep prefixes literal in plain-text composers.
- Track composer-owned slash command elements separately, omit them from exported draft elements, and refresh them when command availability changes.
- Let backward deletion at the start of the text remove the prompt prefix while preserving selected-text deletion and Vim Replace recovery.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for slash prompt cursor placement, prefix deletion, history search highlighting, dynamic command availability, and Vim Replace restoration, including Unicode text. Update rendering snapshots for the slash prompt marker.

prs.title: Reduce memory overhead in tool JSON schemas
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Reduce memory overhead in tool JSON schemas

## Why

Schema strings and sequences do not grow after construction, and most schema nodes do not contain maps. Retaining collection capacity and inline optional maps adds unnecessary memory overhead.

## What changed

Store `JsonSchema` strings and sequences as boxed strings and slices, and box optional property and definition maps. Adapt constructors, schema consumers, and existing test expectations to the new representation while preserving the serialized JSON Schema format.

prs.title: Upgrade `zip` to 9.0.0 and update plugin archive extraction
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Upgrade `zip` to 9.0.0 and update plugin archive extraction

## Why

Curated plugin archives should preserve executable permissions without applying setuid, setgid, or sticky bits.

## What changed

- Upgrade `zip` from 2.4.2 to 9.0.0, retaining the previous feature set and selecting the existing `bzip2-sys` backend explicitly. Update the Cargo and Bazel lockfiles.
- Adapt plugin extraction to fallible entry names and apply Unix permissions through the open output file, using the mode filtered by `zip`.

## Testing

Add a Unix regression test that encodes special permission bits directly in an archive entry and verifies that the extracted file has mode `0o755`.

prs.title: Stop applying macOS background priority to managed daemons
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Stop applying macOS background priority to managed daemons

## What changed

Launch managed app-server and updater processes directly through the shared background command helper, removing the macOS `taskpolicy -b` wrapper and its availability probe. Remove the associated launch-policy tests and macOS daemon-startup test serialization.

Retain the 30-second macOS readiness timeout because older updaters can pass background policy to replacement daemons during upgrades.

prs.title: Defer unknown TUI config fields to the shared strict-config policy
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Defer unknown TUI config fields to the shared strict-config policy

## Why

Unknown fields in TUI keymaps and profile TUI settings fail deserialization even when strict config validation is disabled.

## What changed

Remove Serde's `deny_unknown_fields` from these settings so unknown fields are ignored during deserialization and reported by the shared strict-config policy. Keep `schemars(deny_unknown_fields)` so the generated schema continues to disallow unknown fields.

prs.title: Support typed content in contextual prompt fragments
Add negotiated zstd compression to app-server WebSockets
Share additional tool declarations across response item clones
Preserve model catalog caches across header credential rotation
Gate app-server WebSocket compression behind a feature flag
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Gate app-server WebSocket compression behind a feature flag

## What changed

Add `features.app_server_websocket_compression`, disabled by default. TCP WebSocket and Unix-domain socket listeners now negotiate zstd compression only when the feature is enabled and the client offers the supported protocol. Otherwise, connections use plain text messages.

Include the feature in the configuration schema and allow its override during TUI daemon startup.

## Testing

Extend transport tests to cover enabled and disabled compression with supported, unsupported, and absent client offers on both transports. Add an app-server integration test that verifies startup configuration controls negotiation and the message format used for initialization responses.

prs.title: Allow agent messages to wake idle root sessions behind a feature flag
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Allow agent messages to wake idle root sessions behind a feature flag

## Why

A worker can finish after its parent has returned a final answer. Agent messages without `trigger_turn` previously needed an outstanding durable sleep to wake an idle session.

## What changed

Add the disabled-by-default `wake_on_agent_messages` feature to start a new root turn when agent mail arrives through direct delivery or the host mailbox. Reuse the previous turn context for messages without `trigger_turn`. Keep these automatic wakes disabled for interrupted sessions, Plan mode, and child agents.

## Testing

Add coverage for both delivery paths waking a completed root exactly once, child completion waking a parent after its final answer, and the interruption, Plan mode, and child-agent boundaries.

prs.title: Add observation-only model request lifecycle hooks
